In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DRNets are a promising and powerful framework for solving pattern de- mixing problems, in general.

DRNets have the capability of thinking faster than humans (neural-network-based learning), but also thinking slower than humans (logic-based reasoning), and thus can solve problems in a manner that is both fast and slow, for pattern de-mix problems.

DRNets are a powerful new framework for solving complex pattern de-mixings, and are particularly well-suited for solving problems that are too complex to be tackled by either deep learning or reasoning alone, and where the problem structure is not known or not easily expressible in a neural network
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DRNets can be used as a generic, flexible and effective tool for solving pattern deconvolution tasks in general.

we show that DRNets can think fast (deep neural networks) and slow (logic and constraint reasoning) to solve pattern de-mix problems.

deep neural networks can learn and reason, and can be used as a tool for solving hard problems in science.
